title: Heterogeneous interfaces and bonding
body:
Interfaces often dominate the thermal resistance of integrated devices. We study how atoms bond across them — and how to make bonded interfaces thermally transparent.

Using surface-activated bonding (SAB), annealing, and atomically engineered interlayers, we maximize thermal boundary conductance at semiconductor–semiconductor and semiconductor–dielectric interfaces, while revealing the underlying phonon physics with STEM-EELS, Raman spectroscopy, and machine-learned molecular dynamics.
bodyZh:
界面热阻常常主导集成器件的总热阻。我们研究原子如何跨越界面成键，以及如何让键合界面在热学上透明。

我们利用表面活化键合（SAB）、退火工艺与原子级界面层设计，最大化半导体-半导体及半导体-介质界面的热导，并通过 STEM-EELS、拉曼光谱与机器学习分子动力学揭示其背后的声子物理。

points.en: Room-temperature GaN–diamond SAB bonding with 90 MW/m²·K interface thermal conductance (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020)
points.zh: 室温 GaN-金刚石 SAB 键合，界面热导达 90 MW/m²·K（ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020）

points.en: Annealing-boosted GaN–diamond interface thermal conductance with a nearly 300% improvement (Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025)
points.zh: 退火使 GaN-金刚石界面热导提升近 300%（Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025）

points.en: AlN–SiC interface thermal conductance up to 800 MW/m²·K (arXiv:2602.13827)
points.zh: AlN-SiC 界面热导最高达 800 MW/m²·K（arXiv:2602.13827）

points.en: GaN-on-diamond with a high-thermal-conductivity 3C-SiC interlayer relieving thermal-expansion mismatch (Small 2024)
points.zh: 以高导热 3C-SiC 为中介层的 GaN-on-diamond 结构，缓解热膨胀失配（Small 2024）

points.en: From elastic phonon transmission at ideal Al–Al₂O₃ interfaces to interface phonon modes in Si–Ge — the physics that guides better bonding (Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021)
points.zh: 从理想 Al-Al₂O₃ 界面的弹性声子透射到 Si-Ge 界面局域声子模式——指导更优键合的物理机制（Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021）
